enchantments.text: One of the following ability bonuses:

children.tooltip: Dexterity +8: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Wisdom +8: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +9: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +9 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Enhanced Ki +1: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.
Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one half die.
Concentration +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.
Vitality +20: Passive: +20 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.

children.text: 375 Purple Dragon Knights Favor and 15 Commendation: Villagers of Eveningstar adds Way of the Sun Soul
children.tooltip: Way of the Sun Soul: When all three item from the set are equipped and you are in a centered state, you will gain +2 artifact bonus to To-Hit and Damage rolls. In addition, when you roll a natural 20 on an attack roll that is confirmed as a critical hit, you will gain temporary benefit based on the elemental stance you are in, if any.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
